title: SUM over no rows is BLANK, not 0
query: EVALUATE ROW ( "r", CALCULATE ( SUM ( T[n] ), T[n] > 10 ) )

source.quote: The result is blank in case there are no rows in the table with a non-blank value
source.supports: SUM with nothing to add is BLANK

derivation: T[n] holds 1, 2, 3. No row has n > 10, so SUM has no rows and returns BLANK.
